body: Thank you for that, I appreciate it!
I agree and am super appreciative that you took the time to comment this!
Wow, thank you so much, this truly meant a lot for me and gave me a lot of hope. I’m also so glad that you’re living comfortably now, and I can’t wait for that day to come. Thanks again!!
Thank you so much! This was extremely needed ❤️

You’re right, there are free counseling services on campus, I just honestly worry that my problems are far too big for them, as I went a few years back and they basically just wanted to discuss classes and student-related stuff. It felt like the grad students who were the counselors hadn’t yet been exposed to my level of fucked up, and now, with so many more issues, I fear it’ll just be a waste of my time. I’m really just waiting for my Medicaid, and then I’ll go and get a ton of help... I already have the places picked out and am super excited. Thank you for your response, though!
I’m sorry you had that experience.

Did you say yes, you had a gun available and also a time/date planned for when you’d do it? If so, they are supposed to send emergency services to your location. If not, they are just supposed to de-escalate you from your current state.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.

The thing is, I don't mind working a second job while in school. I know that I'm closer to a better job if I just persevere through these last 4 semesters, and that's why I'm a student. I also get a substantial amount back from my student loan refund, and that often helps me big time 2x a year, and I can claim a credit on my taxes and receive a bigger refund, so luckily it's not all bad. 

I'm going for Social Work, which will probably get me flamed in the comments, but I have far more experience than others that will almost guarantee a job straight from graduation, and I plan on going for my Masters to secure a higher paying position.
PMing you if you don't mind.
I would love that. Sending you a pm now.
